metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the leaving, the penny at Uxbridge, the flint road, and the loft.

yesterday: You were out of the close at ten past four. The lane after Kensington cost a mile.
At Uxbridge the ale was one penny. The bread and the cheese were Jacqueline's, already in the pack. The watchman looked, and let the pack by.
A strap rubbed. You set it and went on.
The loft at Chalfont was two pence, after bacon and pease-pottage. The hay was last year's.
You counted the parcels you packed yesterday and found them the same. The left heel was raw before you took the shoes off.
